name: Kouzuki Mio
source: Mio is a mute underclassman of [url=/c4766]Kouhei's[/url] with abundant expressions. Since she cannot speak, she uses a sketchbook to carry on written conversations. She belongs to the theater club as a junior of [url=/c4883]Yukimi[/url]. While she performs non-speaking parts, she handles her own role reliably.
